testcase.description: BIR51 TC — Paired Detail + Value Elements

variation.name: bir51_tc_paired_details
variation.description: A valid BIR51 tax computation that exercises all paired detail/value validation rules by including non-zero values for each income/expense category that requires a corresponding details text element. Covers service income, management fee income, interest, legal fees, management fee expense, contractor/subcontractor charges, bad debt provision, commission, charitable donations, building refurbishment, environmental protection assets, and share-based payments.
